events.description: Two ice hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, exchanging punches and grappling, until a referee intervenes to separate them.
Two ice hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, involving grappling, punching, and clinching, with a referee intervening to separate them.

Two ice hockey players engage in a sustained physical fight: they grapple, clinch, and exchange punches while on the ice, with one player (in dark jersey) being driven backward and eventually taken down.

After the opponent is down on the ice (visible from f11 onward), the player in the white/blue jersey continues to strike and press down on the fallen player, who is unable to defend himself—constituting abuse of a helpless victim.

A multi-player on-ice fight involving at least three players (including goalie #1 'DURKIN' and opposing player #71) escalating from a scrum near the net into sustained punching, grappling, and shoving; referees intervene late in the sequence.

After being knocked down or pinned, player #16 (in dark jersey) is struck repeatedly by an opponent while in a vulnerable, non-defensive position near the boards, with no immediate referee intervention visible in those frames.
Two ice hockey players engage in a sustained fistfight on the ice, exchanging punches and grappling, with a referee intervening near the end.
Two hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, involving grappling, clinching, and repeated punches; referees intervene progressively to separate them.
After being taken down and appearing helpless on the ice (f9–f11), one player continues to be struck by the other while referees are still intervening, constituting abuse of a defenseless opponent.
